children: US business bank's Q3 operating revenue and EPS rose yr/yr
Company expects expenses to rise as it invests in talent, marketing, and technology
First Business Bank anticipates net interest margin to moderate from Q3 but remain above long-term target
Company expects full-year 2026 effective tax rate between 13% and 15%
CORE DEPOSIT GROWTH - Co said 14.9% yr/yr growth in core deposits outpaced loan growth and improved funding mix
LOAN EXPANSION - Co said loans grew 10.2% yr/yr, driven by CRE and C&I lending across multiple markets
NET INTEREST MARGIN - Co said net interest margin rose to 3.80% from 3.68% yr/yr, helped by loan yields and deposit mix
